digest.component_or_area: Jira executor retry and outcome contract
propositions: Current Jira writes cross multiple retry boundaries (dispatch, Cloud ACLI/REST, DC SDK), allowing timeouts to multiply writes or leave acceptance ambiguous; a single unified retry budget with exact summary writes is needed.

Cloud and DC summary routes must each produce one provider-neutral outcome schema recording logical id, postcondition, invocation/request counts, disposition, failure scope, replay safety, provider delay, and bounded redacted diagnostics.

Three invocations maximum and 15 seconds cumulative sleep is the enforcement boundary; schedule is 2^(attempt+1) + U[0,1) with provider Retry-After as lower bound and budget-overrun delay returns retry_not_before without sleep.

DC writes are exactly GET→PUT→GET per invocation with no hidden repeats; failure ends the invocation; successful read-back is authoritative; ambiguous PUT result consumes a separate GET observation invocation.

Cloud recovery uses primary-store REST get_issue_by_rest (never ACLI JQL) under one-attempt no-sleep policy; desired summary observed after timeout means recovered success; failed or inconclusive observation returns non-replaying commit_unknown.

Handler records exactly one redacted per-mutation message capped at 512 Unicode code points per terminal outcome, leaves _fields_synced empty in S1, advances no baseline/provenance, and emits one completion log per terminal/exhausted outcome containing logical id, disposition, counts, cleanup status, retry_not_before, and redacted message.
